items.title: D-Wave CEO: No Quantum Rival Has Produced “Even One Logical Qubit”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysD-Wave CEO Alan Baratz said no quantum company has built “even one logical qubit” that can run 1 million operations. His claim holds on his own standard, but Quantinuum came within about 5x of it, and D-Wave’s own first such qubit isn’t due until 2028.
